selection: Select representation, optional 32-component PCA and C by pooled inner accuracy, then five-class macro-F1, then declared candidate order. Include training-derived majority fallback. Score only selected pipeline on outer folds.
scope: Separate fixed, locally computed public MiniLM text-embedding extension. No encoder fine-tuning. All transcript token chunks included with length-weighted normalized mean. Original AV study/reference unchanged.
leakage_controls: No participant IDs, labels, questionnaire scores or recorded gender as inputs. Frozen per-document encoder has no adaptation to any local data. Scaler, PCA and classifier fit only inner/outer fitting participants. Whole interview text; speaker identity unavailable.
limitations: Post-final exploratory development on reused training folds after prior experiments. No independent confirmation, no new validation/test scoring, no final refit or reference replacement. Public encoder pretraining overlap with this corpus is unknown. No post-hoc expansion of this declared search after outer results.
